classification_rationale: Compound and notable: several sub-clauses (deployed contract MUST NOT use selfdestruct/delegatecall/callcode) can reuse req-1-self-destruct's and req-1-delegatecall's ALREADY-SCOPED predicates, just applied to the CREATE2-deployed target's code rather than the calling contract's own code -- a genuine cross-requirement reuse opportunity found while writing this record. 'Within the Tested Code' (deployment-completeness) and 'compatible with the claims of the contract author' remain semantic/evidence questions.
